local_articles.snippet: McLaren have taken a big step forward and Mercedes no longer have the quickest car in Formula One, championship leader Kimi Antonelli said after Sunday's Dutch Grand Prix. McLaren's reigning champion Lando Norris celebrated his second win in a row from pole position at Zandvoort, with Antonelli and Mercedes teammate George Russell second and third ahead of Ferrari pair Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc. "We’re clearly not the fastest car anymore on the grid," said Antonelli, who won five races in a row earlier in the season. "We’re probably second or third, at least in today’s race, and McLaren has taken a huge step, especially since Hungary, since the big upgrade package they brought." local_articles.title: Gaza documentary to premiere at Venice film festival
local_articles.snippet: ROME: A new documentary called “NAZA” from the same directors as the Oscar-winning Israeli-Palestinian production “No Other Land” will premiere at the Venice Film Festival next month, organizers said on Monday. The film, which will be in competition for the Golden Lion award, is about “the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza,” according to a synopsis published on the film festival website. The film is directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, two of the four co-directors of “No Other Land,” which tells the story of Palestinian activists trying to protect a cluster of villages in the occupied West Bank from demolition by the Israeli military. NAZA is produced by The Guardian and James Wilson (JW Films) and executive-produced by Jonathan Glazer.
